name: THUG Vita
author: iwannagooutside
description:
Native PS Vita port of Tony Hawk's Underground (2003). Not an emulator: the whole engine is rebuilt for the Vita with a vitaGL graphics backend.
Story mode, free skate, Create-a-Skater and every level, most at or near 60 fps. No game data included: you need your own copy of the game.
